plan.note: Bounded known-only witness search. Unknown reveals stop the hypothetical route; their actual faces are never sampled from the real board. Optional public-geometry exposure values newly readable fields without querying them; already known physical continuations remain searchable, and actual observations occur after every tap. Clock distance is an ordering heuristic, not a proven bound. A knownDead certificate requires a fully exhausted known graph with no new information or unsupported transition, pruning only separately certified losses. Excluded heuristic roots require a separate bounded search sharing the remaining node budget before a death certificate; it chooses an actual losing/progressing tap rather than calling a computation cap a failure. A returned win/exit has a constructive physical witness; other absence is not a proof of loss, uniqueness or optimality. Automatic Joker transitions outside the public transition model remain unresolved.

reopenAudit.note: Known reopens require a constructive win/clock-exit witness, or optionally guaranteed progress instead of an immediate physical loss. Optional nonclock information escape requires a safe known prefix, real removal progress and a final tray of at most2 instead of the primary crowded endpoint. All probes share the original node budget. A heuristic root exclusion alone cannot certify a dead end.

confidence.note: Paired Monte Carlo differences on identical completed fillings; conditional heuristic evidence, not a proof or a calibrated human success probability.
